name: Duplicate pings (same driver + timestamp)
finding: 92 extra rows (39 exact copies, 53 with different coordinates). v1 counts them all.

name: Late / out-of-order pings
finding: 121 pings arrived after a newer ping (latest 39 min late). In arrival order v1 jumps back and forth: ~572.7 km of jump-back lines (before zone filter).

name: GPS noise: more than 100 m off the road
finding: 33 pings off the road (worst 484 m). v1 uses them.

name: GPS noise: implied speed above 150 km/h
finding: 31 pings imply >150 km/h vs the last valid ping. A naive check vs the previous ping flags 62 - it would also throw away 31 good pings.

name: Day cut: UTC date vs report date (00:00 UTC+9)
finding: 1468 pings fall on a different date in UTC than in UTC+9 (everything 00:00-09:00 local). 3 in-zone segments cross local midnight. v1 books by UTC date.

name: Zone boundary: segments crossing the zone edge
finding: 50 segments cross the zone edge. v1 counts a whole segment if its start is inside: 149.042 km vs 148.942 km clipped (+0.101 km).

name: Distance formula: flat degrees vs great-circle
finding: On the same in-zone segments v1's flat-degree formula gives 170.25 km vs 152.54 km haversine (+11.6%). Longitude degrees are treated as 111 km; at 37.5N they are 88 km.
